cards.subtitle: Building the personas and labeled pairs the loop trains on.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · LABELS MIRROR REAL LANDING RATES

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Loop needs labeled pairs — which intros landed, which died.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Generated 60 synthetic personas with real-shaped paths and asks.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Labels look too kind. Everything lands in this cohort.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Recalibrated: topic-only pairs land near 41%, like history.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Held out a slice of pairs — the loop never trains on them.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Personas embed cleanly. Cohort is ready to run.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Generation zero starts from these labels. Go.

cards.subtitle: Refitting weights each generation and watching the rate climb.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Generation zero: domain-heavy weights, 41% connection-rate.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Each generation I re-rank the cohort under the refit weights.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: My scorer grades every generation's picks on the held-out pairs.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Generation three dipped. Maybe we're overfitting the cohort.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Held-out scores kept climbing — the dip was noise, not overfit.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Generation six: trajectory + seeking dominate. Rate hits 84%.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Every refit's rationale logged alongside the run.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Curve is real and monotone-ish. Loop complete.

cards.subtitle: Freezing the run so the demo replays it exactly.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · run.json IS THE SINGLE SOURCE

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Full run serialized to run.json — every generation, every score.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Replay must land the same 41% → 84% curve every time.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Live refit on stage would be braver than a replay.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Braver and riskier. The demo replays; the loop stays honest.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Village and graph both read run.json — one file drives both.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Replayed three times. Identical curve, identical picks.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Generation-six weights promoted. Run frozen.
